tested_shape.dataclass_fields: _factory_seal and _factory_payload_sha256 are ordinary dataclass init fields; neither is init=False

observation: The new payload-digest fence defeats a plain dataclasses.replace(public_field=...) because the preserved old _factory_payload_sha256 no longer matches. It still does not establish unforgeable factory origin inside the Python object model: dataclasses.replace can preserve the exact private seal object automatically and the caller can also provide a recomputed _factory_payload_sha256 for the modified public as_dict payload. No secret is required because the seal is carried by the source object and the digest algorithm is deterministic/publicly reproducible.
setup: Create one valid binding with bind_reentry_to_uptake() so it carries the exact module-private _factory_seal and factory payload digest.
Choose a different but syntactically valid lineage-bearing public field, e.g. broadcast_sha256.
Compute the canonical digest that the modified binding.as_dict() will have. This is deterministic JSON/SHA-256 and does not require the private seal value.

Use dataclasses.replace(valid_binding, broadcast_sha256=<forged>, _factory_payload_sha256=<recomputed modified payload digest>). Do not override _factory_seal; replace copies that init field from the valid source object.
Call assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin() and then the WP717 validate_gwt_event_binding consumer with matching gwt_ref.
failure_signature: A post-factory structurally replaced binding with recomputed _factory_payload_sha256 passes factory-origin validation while its lineage-bearing public content no longer equals the exact factory-validated WP507/WP508 evidence.
why_high_information: This tests the repaired helper itself rather than the pre-fix seal-only shape. It distinguishes tamper-evident cached payload identity from actual factory/source-lineage authority.
repair_guidance: Preferred small object-level hardening: make _factory_seal and any factory-cache field init=False so dataclasses.replace/direct constructor cannot preserve or supply them; set them only with object.__setattr__ inside the admitted factory after validation.

For strongest exact GWT semantics, continue to use validate_reentry_uptake_binding with exact witness/uptake/plan/selection/broadcast/cell_input source objects at the promotion boundary, or bind an immutable admitted proof to those exact objects.
Do not create a second GWT authority and do not promote GWT/J-Space runtime merely because an object passes reference-lineage validation.
